## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector returns (only Energy, Technology, Financials and Real Estate up) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5 largely tech), with major divergences among large caps suppressing a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Energy lead: PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.77% | 1M: +5.23%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.53% | 1M: +9.91%), OXY RECOVERY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: -6.04%). Technology lead: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%), AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%). Financials: SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +8.09%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Materials weak: SHW CORRECTION (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +7.55%), PPG CORRECTION (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +0.34%). Healthcare soft: ABBV CORRECTION (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%), LLY CORRECTION (1W: -2.09% | 1M: +3.84%). Consumer Staples lag: PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -3.78%), KO not listed but staples showing weakness overall.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%), AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%), OXY RECOVERY (1W: +8.14% | 1M: -6.04%), CSCO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +1.17%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — Growth/Momentum style but concentration is a caution.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: CHTR BELOW TREND (1W: -4.72% | 1M: -3.43%), PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -3.78%), ABBV CORRECTION (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%), SHW CORRECTION (1W: -5.25% | 1M: +7.55%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -9.88%) — weakness concentrated in Communication and select defensives.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Top 1W movers: META (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%) ABOVE TREND, CSCO (1W: +8.05% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +17.32%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (≥3 large-cap names with 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical momentum not universal confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed but leadership-driven: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.17% | 1M: +8.53%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -4.54%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -0.76% | 1M: -1.94%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%); Technology is one of the 4/11 positive sectors but breadth is narrow.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Generally constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +8.09%), SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%), V CORRECTION (1W: -3.63% | 1M: +7.36%), MA CORRECTION (1W: -2.18% | 1M: +6.54%); Financials are among the few positive sectors but show pockets of short-term exhaustion.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Soft overall with rotational signs: ABBV CORRECTION (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +10.05%), JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -2.30% | 1M: +8.43%), LLY CORRECTION (1W: -2.09% | 1M: +3.84%), PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -5.95%) — defensive leadership is not dominant.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor selective exposure to Tech leaders and high-performing Financials: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%), SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +8.09%). Reduce exposure to weak staples and deeply lagging names (PEP BELOW TREND (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -3.78%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -9.88%)); monitor major divergences for regime change.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: META ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%), AVGO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%).  
BEARISH: MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.38% | 1M: -4.54%), NFLX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -9.88%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -8.73% | 1M: +1.78%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.69%, driven by OXY RECOVERY and refiner strength) and Technology (1W: +2.14%, narrow leadership).  
BEARISH: Materials (1W: -2.05%) and Healthcare (1W: -1.58%) where short-term weakness and corrections are visible.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA holding the recent breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation and META momentum for sector leadership; MSFT breaching recent 1W lows would confirm broader tech softening and deepen the divergence; JPM sustaining 1M strength would validate Financials participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
AVGO (+60): Broadcom lands large Apple chip deal; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.96% | 1M: +2.15%) — sentiment confirmed.  
BA (+55): Boeing production line news; price CORRECTION (1W: -1.86% | 1M: +3.62%) — sentiment diverging from short-term price.  
DE (+55): Deere right-to-repair deal; price CORRECTION (1W: -5.54% | 1M: +1.91%) — sentiment bullish but price shows short-term pullback.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
META (-50): headline on AI progress skepticism; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%) — sentiment diverging (distribution risk to monitor).  
CRM (-50): negative AI product coverage; price in mixed state (not in top performers) — sentiment aligns with recent pressure on cloud/AI tools.  
MMM (-60): PFAS litigation headline; price likely under pressure (industrial risk) — sentiment confirms downside risk in Industrials.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum drift with narrow leadership concentrated in Technology. META ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.81% | 1M: +14.58%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.28% | 1M: +1.33%), SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.31% | 1M: +16.17%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence across large caps and mixed news sentiment (e.g., META negative headlines amid price strength) — monitor for confirmation before increasing beta.
